units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 31b:8">B. Kam. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>כחוטרא דס׳</he> Ms. R. (ed. <he>דסמיותא</he>) barring the road in the position of a blind man’s groping staff.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 52a:5">Ib. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>כד רגיז</he> … <he>לנגדא ס׳</he> Ms. R. (ed. <cite ref="O01075"><he>סַמְוָתָא</he></cite>) when the shepherd is angry with his flock, he makes the leader blind.
